recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟 H&E 下，藍色的淋巴細胞浸潤瀰漫散布於充血的紅髓中，並圍繞中央一條粉紅色纖維小樑或血管，未見正常清楚的白髓濾泡；脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤可呈這種白髓擴張合併紅髓浸潤的樣式，但此倍率無法評估細胞細節。
features: Low-power splenic section with a mottled pattern of blue lymphoid cells and red blood cell-rich areas
Lymphoid infiltrate diffusely involves the red pulp cords and sinuses rather than being confined to white pulp
Vague, poorly delineated nodular lymphoid areas without identifiable germinal centers or mantle zones
Central pink fibrous trabecula/vessel surrounded by lymphoid cells
Cytologic detail (cell size, marginal zone pale cytoplasm) is not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate permeating the congested red pulp, with vague nodular aggregates and a central fibrous trabecula. Normal white pulp architecture with distinct germinal centers and mantle zones is not recognizable in this field. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In combination with the monotypic plasmacytic component and immunostains in this case, the pattern is consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma with red pulp involvement.

ddx.vs: Diffusely infiltrates red pulp forming blood lakes while effacing white pulp, with cells having abundant clear cytoplasm and CD103/CD25/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positivity.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Involves red pulp diffusely without white pulp nodularity and lacks the biphasic marginal zone pattern.
Shows white pulp expansion with proliferation centers and CD5/CD23/LEF1 positivity.
Retains well-formed white pulp follicles with germinal centers and polytypic B cells without diffuse red pulp lymphoid infiltration.
